description: Payment golden benchmark — naive should fail CRITICAL, improved should PASS or have <=1 MEDIUM

improved.notes: Improved establishes pending + idempotency before external call, uses timeout, transaction, and idempotent webhook — only no_rate_limit may remain

expected_plan_findings: External side-effect before durable local state
Enrollment not gated on verified payment

invariants: A student must never be enrolled without a successful payment
A payment must never be charged twice
